raw_text_excerpt: Girija Goyal, Ph.D. Skip to Main Content Wyss Institute Menu Search Site Who We Are About How We Work How We Collaborate Team Careers Contact Our Work Technologies Impact Report Publications Collaborations AI DataHub Brain Targeting Program Collaborative Fund Alliance Diagnostics Accelerator Global Development Program Nucleic Acid Delivery Consortium Northpond Labs Alliance Scientific Instrumentation Program Newsroom News Press Resources Multimedia Events Give Search Girija Goyal, Ph.D. Director, Bioinspired Therapeutics Linked in BlueSky Facebook Girija is an immunologist working with the organs-on-chips and diagnostics platforms to design better in vitro models of the human immune system and assays to test the performance of immunotherapeutics and vaccines. Her research has come full circle after, as these in vitro models are now informing decision making at pharma and how to create cellular and tissue based therapeutics. Recently, she secured a prestigious Spark contract from ARPA-H
